aliases: twinr-ram, twinr-shield, twinr-link answer to the same anchors (one painting serves both twins)

api.setBroken: rig.setBroken({'twinl-ram': true}) or rig.state.broken[id] = true; ?broken=id,id|all (short ids ram, shield, link ok)
api.anchor: rig.anchor(id) returns [x, y, r] in CSS pixels of .stage, already mirrored to match what is drawn
api.flip: the page mirrors the painting with CSS so it faces left; open it with ?noflip=1 for the painting's own facing (ram to the right), or mirror .stage in the game
api.stage: stage aspect 1936 x 1392 (painting plus pad 520 x 120)

anchorsNote: anchors in this file are unmirrored painting pixels; the ram, shield and lens are on the painting's right (x grows toward the target)
